Pose · prototype

The three game rooms

Each room is one screen: the painted title carries it, then the three questions every room asks — what the format is, who is at the table, what it pays — and one button. Every piece of art is now in place; what is left is export work on three files, not new drawing.

The rooms

No text header, and no headings over the choices — the tiles name themselves. The chosen one goes see-through with a gold ring around it, so the room shows through what you picked. The rewards board is a sign rather than a receipt: it says the one thing worth saying, big, and puts the numbers under it. Partner has no table size and no seat diagram — it is always four with partners opposite. A friends room asks what kind of table first, and swaps the half below it.

The art, and what is left

Sizes are the source files as supplied. Where a file needs work before it can ship, it says so.

SlotStatusFileNotes
Cut Throat Online titleready Cut-Throat-Online.png
1075 × 716		 True transparency, art edge to edge. Placed as-is.
Partner titleready Partner.png
1075 × 716		 Same ratio as Cut Throat, so the two heroes line up exactly.
Classic 6 Love tileready classic6love-slam.png
1170 × 658		 True transparency. Trims to 1.73:1.
Quick Love tileneeds re-export quicklove.png
1241 × 620		 Opaque white background — cut out here. It also trims to 3.5:1 against Classic's 1.73:1, so the two are fitted inside one box rather than stretched. It reads fine, but a version with the art brought in closer would pair better.
One-Love titleneeds re-export onelove-friends.png
1316 × 585		 Opaque white background — cut out here. A long banner (2.6:1) where the other titles are stacked blocks, so it is placed wider and shorter.
Rewards boardneeds re-export rewards-board.png
1851 × 850		 RGB, no alpha channel at all — cut out here. Used as a frame: numbers sit on the plank, clear of the flowers at lower-left and the chest from 69% across.

Three files have opaque backgrounds. onelove-friends.png and quicklove.png are near-white, and rewards-board.png has no alpha channel at all — on the dark wood ground each would draw as a white box. All three were cut out automatically for this mockup, which is good enough to judge the layout but leaves a faint grey wisp under the One-Love underline. Re-export them with real transparency and they drop straight in with no layout change.

One-Love keeps its join field. The room is otherwise built exactly like Cut Throat — format, then players, then rewards — but joining someone else's table is the point of the mode, so the code field stays below the Create button. The room code and the waiting seats are not on this screen: they belong to the state after Create, which is how the current build already works.

Screens are drawn at the real 800 × 1730 canvas ratio. Type is Baloo 2 and Nunito, the pair DESIGN_SYSTEM.md §3 specifies; colours are §2 tokens; the wood is board.png. The money is real — 1,000 entry and the 2,000 key bonus from ADR 0016, the pot from economy.ts, the 30-second clock from TurnTimer.
